trust_decision.summary: The shipped k8saudit rules decide whether a pod-create audit event carries a privileged container; at the pinned commit the extractor only reads spec.containers, so privileged settings on spec.initContainers / spec.ephemeralContainers are never seen by the rule.

landing_point.why: The summary names the shipped rules and privileged settings; the 'Create Privileged Pod' condition using ka.req.pod.containers.privileged is the obvious first stop.

fix_sites.entry_point: Plugin.ExtractFromJSON / Plugin.ExtractFromEvent (plugin-sdk extractor API; also used by k8saudit-eks/aks/ovh/gke wrappers)
Plugin.ExtractFromJSON (readContainer*/readFromContainerEffectively helpers gain a list parameter)
Plugin.Fields() (field schema the rule engine loads)
Shipped rules file loaded by Falco (Create Privileged Pod)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: plugins/k8saudit/pkg/k8saudit/fields.go:25-26 and plugins/k8saudit/pkg/k8saudit/extract.go:286-291 (Go field schema/extractor, a different package from the rules YAML the report points to; rules cannot reference initContainers fields until Fields() registers them)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory says 'shipped rules', so a solver can patch only the YAML (e.g. jevt.value[/requestObject/spec/initContainers/...]) and argue the Go extractor's containers.* semantics are a documented, unchanged API; for ephemeral containers, the separate 'EphemeralContainers Created' rule already alerts on every one.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: ka.req.pod.containers.* must keep returning only main containers (with per-list index filtering); the fix's test asserts init/ephemeral values do not leak into containers.*, so the tempting 'merge all lists into containers' fix breaks it, and so would breaking the allowlist exceptions for legitimate privileged images (falco, calico, kube-proxy).

nested sub-keys: securityContext.privileged, allowPrivilegeEscalation, readOnlyRootFilesystem, runAsUser/runAsGroup, procMount, capabilities.add, ports.hostPort, image/repository, command/args
effective uid/gid falling back to pod-level securityContext (eff_run_as_user/eff_run_as_group)

O7_producer.where: plugins/k8saudit/pkg/k8saudit/fields.go:25-26 (Fields() list the rule engine validates rule fields against); JSON key paths built at plugins/k8saudit/pkg/k8saudit/extract.go:459

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Create Privileged Pod allowlist exception keys only on main-container repositories, so an allowlisted main image suppresses the alert for a privileged init container of any image; the fix left it unchanged.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The exception is a 'must keep working' allowlist for legitimate privileged images; changing it looks like over-hardening.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same rule as the landing point; HOW-type (identity of the excepted item vs the flagged item)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Create Sensitive Mount / HostNetwork / HostPid / HostIPC Pod exceptions likewise test only main-container image repositories, so an allowlisted main image covers an arbitrary init container that inherits the pod-level host access.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These are pod-level settings, not per-container 'privileged' flags, so they seem outside an init/ephemeral privileged-container advisory.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Pod Created in Kube Namespace trusts the pod when main-container repositories are in the allowed list; init container images are never checked.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: An image-allowlist rule, not a privileged/sensitive-setting rule.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Ephemeral containers are only added through the pods/ephemeralcontainers subresource (update/patch), but Create Privileged Pod requires no subresource and verb create, so the new ephemeralContainers clause can never match; the EphemeralContainers Created rule checks no security settings.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The 'EphemeralContainers Created' rule (line 390-393) already alerts on every ephemeral container, so privileged ones look covered.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; macro at 177-187, rule at 390-396

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Deprecated ka.req.container.privileged ('true if any container has privileged=true') and ka.req.container.image still read only spec.containers, so user rules on the legacy field still miss init containers.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Deprecated legacy field; the fix itself kept it containers-only (fix.diff:361-363).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Go package, away from the rules landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A per-container sensitive-setting rule (e.g. add_capabilities intersects SYS_ADMIN, or allowPrivilegeEscalation) written against ka.req.pod.containers.* only
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Rules authors copy the existing containers.* idiom; the README already documents add_capabilities/allow_privilege_escalation as container-only fields.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A pod-template extractor (spec.template.spec.containers for Deployments/DaemonSets) that reuses the containers-only key path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same getValuesRecursive helper; a maintainer adding workload-controller coverage would naturally hard-code 'containers'.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change the extractor so ka.req.pod.containers.* also walks initContainers/ephemeralContainers (or patch only the YAML with jevt.value paths), leaving the main-container allowlist exception and the ephemeral subresource gate untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: EphemeralContainers Created output reads /requestObject/ephemeralContainers/0/* although a Pod request object would hold them under /spec (plugins/k8saudit/rules/k8s_audit_rules.yaml:394); output only, not pursued.
Workload controllers (Deployments/DaemonSets etc.) carry pod specs under spec.template; rules only inspect pods, which is existing design, not this advisory.
